items.title: File Widerspruch against Elterngeld decision
items.quote: Dieser Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, mit dem Widerspruch angefochten werden.
items.computation: Letter dated 16.11.2026 (Monday). Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a letter sent by post is deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the third day after it was handed to the post, i.e. 16.11.2026 + 3 days = 19.11.2026 (Thursday, not a holiday) → Bekanntgabe = 19.11.2026. Per § 26 SGB X i.V.m. §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB, the one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after Bekanntgabe (20.11.2026) and ends one month later on the day with the same number as the Bekanntgabe date, i.e. 19.12.2026. That date is a Saturday; under § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next business day. 20.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday 21.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

items.title: Report any change in income during Elterngeld payment period
items.quote: Ändert sich Ihr Einkommen während des Bezugs, teilen Sie uns das bitte unverzüglich mit.
items.computation: This is an ongoing obligation to report ('unverzüglich' = without undue delay) triggered by a future event (an income change), not a fixed calendar deadline; the letter gives no specific date by which this must happen.
